title: Spatial Audio: Distance × Azimuth Interaction Table
purpose: A standalone Python script that computes combined PannerNode levels (distance model gain × equalpower panning) for two refDistance scenes across three azimuths. It makes the -3.01 dB straight-ahead trap and the refDistance shift legible without a browser. Produces a printed table; no WAV, no browser needed. Use as a companion to spatial_model.py from art_01M6SGCBMEEBQYN1Z8T18ANGPA rev 1.
attribution: Formulas: Web Audio API specification as documented in art_01M6SGCBMEEBQYN1Z8T18ANGPA revision 1 (source_inspected; execution not_run). No browser was used.
execution: See separate execution receipts; publication alone is not a passed test.
